title: Overhanging Book-Display Rack — Distributed Loading, Bending, and Deflection
summary: Analyze an overhanging book-display rail under self-weight and three equivalent distributed book loads, then check bending strength and deflection.
courseTopic: Overhanging beams under piecewise distributed loads
imageAlt: A freestanding book-display rack with books suspended from a longitudinal rail.
imageAttribution: Dobroš, Knihovnička se závěsem na knihy, own work, CC BY-SA 4.0.
idealizedImageAlt: Corrected instructor-only overhanging-beam loading diagram with supports, rail self-weight, and three book-load intervals.
problemStatement: A furniture maker is evaluating a freestanding rack whose longitudinal rail projects beyond two interior supports. Model the rail as a prismatic overhanging Euler–Bernoulli beam carrying its uniform self-weight and three equivalent uniformly distributed book loads. The values are assigned instructional data, not measurements from the photograph.
engineeringGoal: Determine reactions, shear and moment response, extreme-fiber bending stress, and the maximum absolute vertical deflection; then compare the rail with the assigned strength and serviceability criteria without treating this beam check as certification of the complete furniture.
